design_philosophy.core_concept: Italian Craftsmanship meets German Engineering. Clean, industrial, reliable, yet stylish.
design_philosophy.emotional_tone: Professional, Trustworthy, Efficient, Masculine but refined.
anti_ai_rules: NO generic 'SaaS Blue' gradients. Use the specific Deep Blue (#1E3A5F) as a flat, commanding color.
NO 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Barlow' or 'Oswald' to evoke the automotive industry.
NO boring tables for financial data. Use 'Receipt' style cards or 'Dashboard Dials'.
Avoid 'soft' rounded corners (20px+). Use tighter radii (4px-8px) for a mechanical, precision feel.

typography.instructions: Import 'Barlow' (weights 400, 500, 600, 700) and 'Public Sans' from Google Fonts in index.css.

primary.usage: Main navigation, primary buttons, active states, headers

destructive.usage: Overdue payments, Negative cash flow, Delete actions

structure.mobile: Bottom navigation bar (fixed). Top 'Action Bar' with page title and primary action. Content scrollable in between.
structure.desktop: Left sidebar (fixed, width 280px). Top header for search/profile. Main content area with max-width container.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-md font-medium px-4 py-2 shadow-sm transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-input hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-md font-medium px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90 rounded-md font-medium px-4 py-2 shadow-sm

cards.base: bg-white rounded-lg border border-border/60 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
cards.metric: p-6 flex flex-col justify-between h-full relative overflow-hidden

inputs.default: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

navigation.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white border-t border-border flex justify-around items-center h-16 z-50 pb-safe
navigation.sidebar: hidden md:flex flex-col w-64 bg-primary text-primary-foreground h-screen fixed left-0 top-0 border-r border-border/10

textures: Use a subtle 'noise' overlay on the sidebar to give it a matte finish.
Use a 'striped' pattern (repeating-linear-gradient) for tax deadline progress bars.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE THE CSS VARIABLES in index.css FIRST using the values provided in 'colors.css_variables'. This sets the foundation.
2. INSTALL FONTS: Add the import for Barlow and Public Sans to index.css.
3. IMPLEMENT THE LAYOUT: Create the Layout component with Sidebar (Desktop) and BottomNav (Mobile).
4. BUILD DASHBOARD: Use the 'Bento' grid rules. Create 'MetricCard' components that use the specific icons and colors.
5. USE ITALIAN LANGUAGE: All UI text must be in Italian. (e.g., 'Dashboard' -> 'Bacheca', 'Jobs' -> 'Lavori', 'Settings' -> 'Impostazioni').
7. MOBILE OPTIMIZATION: Ensure all click targets are at least 44px height. Add 'pb-20' to the main content container to avoid overlap with the bottom nav.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: - Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
- Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
- Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
- Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
- You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
- You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
- Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
- NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 etc for icons.
- Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
- Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
